definitions.explanation: The ability to see; the clearness or sharpness of vision.

examples.english: My eyesight got worse, so I got glasses.

notes:
{視力|しりょく} refers to eyesight or visual acuity. {視|し} means 'seeing' and {力|りょく} means 'power.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {視力|しりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧: to have good eyesight
- {視力|しりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: to have poor eyesight
- {視力|しりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: eyesight declines
- {視力|しりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}する→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: to recover eyesight
- {視力|しりょく}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: vision test
- {視力|しりょく}⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧: vision correction

VISION MEASUREMENT (JAPAN):
- In Japan, vision is measured on a decimal scale
- 1.0 = normal vision (20/20 in US)
- 0.1 = very poor vision
- ⟦{裸眼|らがん}→裸眼：20622_ragan⟧{視力|しりょく}: uncorrected vision
- ⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧{視力|しりょく}: corrected vision
